column1: chapter|page|layout|turn|panels

1|1|wide_top_two_insets|Make the bed a concrete promise.|[W] Tiny NIL beneath a towering registration facade; delivery pipes dwarf the queue. >> CAPTION: The job came with a bed. ~~ [C] A worn notice; BED is the cleanest, most reread word. >> NOTICE: Repair apprentice. Trial week. Bed and supper. ~~ [C] NIL's eyes lift from BED toward the closing-hours clock; hope is cautious, not blank. >> NOTICE: Apply before the ninth bell.

1|2|three_vertical_beats|Show useful hands before a missing number.|[C] A loose screw lets the notice sag. ~~ [C] NIL's thumbnail tightens the screw; the other hand steadies the paper. >> SFX: tik ~~ [M] NIL enters the queue, trying to stand like an applicant. >> CAPTION: The foreman sent them here for an account record.

1|3|four_regular|The request meets the wrong form.|[M] Clerk behind glass; NIL leans forward, guardedly eager. >> CLERK: Employment record? // NIL: I want to start one. ~~ [C] Clerk's pencil waits above ACCOUNT. >> CLERK: Number? ~~ [C] Five empty boxes; the sixth contains NIL. ~~ [EC] Pencil draws a single line through NIL. >> SFX: skrit

1|4|three_horizontal|Differentiate a field value from a person.|[M] Clerk examines the paper instead of NIL. >> CLERK: That's a field value. No entry. ~~ [C] NIL's jaw tightens but their voice stays level. >> CLERK: Why put it here? // NIL: It's what I have. ~~ [M] NIL holds the crossed-out form below the counter; allow negative space above their hands. >> CLERK: You need a registered sponsor.

1|5|four_regular|Expose the loop in sponsorship.|[M] NIL points back toward the canal yard. >> NIL: The employer sent me here. ~~ [C] Clerk's pencil taps the sponsor line. >> CLERK: Ask them. ~~ [C] NIL looks directly through the glass. >> NIL: They won't until I have an account. ~~ [W] A delivery cylinder arrives beside the stalled applicant. >> SFX: tok

1|6|three_horizontal|The system can move quickly for something.|[C] Clerk signs the cylinder wrapper. ~~ [C] Cylinder drops into an approved tray. >> SFX: clack ~~ [M] NIL still holds the rejected form in the same position. >> NIL: Is the job still open? // CLERK: Ask the employer.

1|7|wide_two_insets|A specific opportunity closes.|[W] NIL on the office stairs as the ninth bell begins; city depth stays matte and readable. >> SFX: DONG ~~ [C] Their hopeful mouth settles into a line. ~~ [C] The notice behind them trembles on its now-tight screw. >> CAPTION: Before the ninth bell.

1|8|three_horizontal|Keep the ordinary goal alive after rejection.|[W] Fourteen steps; a thread warns of a chipped third step. ~~ [C] NIL folds the rejected form around a brass washer. ~~ [M] Right cuff catches on the fused decoder; NaN flickers separately overhead. >> CAPTION: NIL was a private designation, not yet a chosen name.

1|9|two_large|Introduce the baker through an accident.|[W] Baker saves a tilted tray beneath a leaking pipe. ~~ [C] One bun lands against NIL's boot; NIL stares down, solemn. >> SFX: plop // BAKER: Don't eat that.

1|10|four_regular|The first joke belongs to breakfast.|[M] NIL keeps both hands visible, innocent. >> NIL: I wasn't going to. ~~ [C] Baker retrieves the bun. >> BAKER: Good. It costs four fen. ~~ [C] Mud marks the bun's underside; Baker raises an eyebrow. >> NIL: You said not to eat it. ~~ [M] Baker returns to work without dismissing NIL. >> BAKER: I know where your boot's been. // NIL: So do I.

1|11|three_horizontal|NIL chooses to ask rather than disappear.|[M] Rain beyond the awning; NIL waits just inside it. >> BAKER: Waiting for something? ~~ [C] NIL glances at the muddy bun's separate plate. >> NIL: Its price. // BAKER: One fen. ~~ [C] A polished washer rests on the counter. >> SFX: tink

1|12|four_regular|A useless offer becomes a useful lead.|[C] Baker lifts the washer, unsurprised. >> BAKER: That's a washer. // NIL: You might need one. ~~ [M] She returns it carefully. >> BAKER: I need money more. ~~ [C] NIL pockets it with embarrassment held in the shoulders. >> NIL: Anyone need a repair apprentice? ~~ [M] Baker indicates the Bazaar road. >> BAKER: Gus. Needs three. Can afford half of one.

1|13|three_horizontal|Skill and displayed status disagree.|[W] Across the lane, porter Civic 04 shelters clerk Civic 63 beneath an umbrella. ~~ [M] Umbrella turns inside out; clerk complains while porter repairs its wire. ~~ [C] NIL watches the working fingers, then looks back at the bowls. >> NIL: I could work for it.

1|14|four_regular|A small attainable bargain restores movement.|[M] Baker measures NIL and the dirty bowl stack. >> BAKER: Three washed bowls. One bun. ~~ [C] NIL counts the enormous stack, distrustful. >> NIL: Any three? ~~ [C] Baker's mouth barely moves. >> BAKER: Any three that aren't clean. ~~ [M] Gloves beside the basin; bare hands in cold water, right decoder still attached. >> NIL: Fair. // BAKER: You're new here.

1|15|three_horizontal|Let another person interrupt the counting.|[C] NIL studies an old resin repair around a bowl's rim. ~~ [M] Tobi on the stall rail, yellow hood and three bottle-cap charms. >> TOBI: It won't get cleaner if you threaten it. ~~ [C] NIL loosens their grip; Tobi solemnly approves. >> NIL: I'm not. // TOBI: There. It knows.

1|16|four_regular|Earn a small near-smile.|[M] Tobi points to the clean bowl stack. >> TOBI: Start with those. ~~ [C] NIL genuinely considers the loophole. >> NIL: They're clean. ~~ [C] Tobi holds a straight face. >> TOBI: Exactly. ~~ [C] Tobi cracks first; NIL almost smiles. >> AMA: Tobi. At least ask their name.

1|17|three_horizontal|Ama has work and competence before danger.|[M] Ama arrives with an oilcloth-wrapped repaired coat; saved thread winds onto a card. ~~ [M] Tobi takes the too-wide parcel while Ama steadies it above a puddle. >> TOBI: All the way. // AMA: Then I won't have to. ~~ [C] Ama's Civic 01 above practical mended clothes; her smile includes NIL. >> AMA: I'm Ama. Thank you for keeping him occupied.

1|18|three_horizontal|Social naming meets a private blank.|[M] Baker dries the two washed bowls. >> BAKER: My employee drives a hard bargain. // NIL: Two bowls. ~~ [C] Ama sees NaN but does not recoil. >> AMA: What should I call you? ~~ [C] NIL's answer stalls; the basin fills the foreground. >> NIL: I haven't decided.

1|19|four_regular|Connection must exist before it is threatened.|[C] Tobi brightens at the possibility. >> TOBI: Can you decide twice? ~~ [M] Ama gives him a familiar look. >> TOBI: I changed my mind about chimney inspecting. // AMA: After one chimney. ~~ [C] Tobi defends his career, absolutely serious. >> TOBI: Important chimney. ~~ [M] Baker leaves a clean cloth beside NIL. >> BAKER: I'm Baker for bread. Otherwise, you there.

1|20|wide_two_insets|Change the meaning of a polite gesture.|[W] Ama and Tobi approach the market arch; Collector seems to step aside. ~~ [C] Collector sets a fitted brass case on the rail. >> SFX: click ~~ [M] Ama stops; Tobi nearly bumps her, parcel caught between them. >> COLLECTOR: Your account.

1|21|three_horizontal|Turn a routine dispute into an imminent act.|[C] Six separate lights in a jar; Ama's receipt held beside the official notice. ~~ [M] NIL sets down the third bowl; Baker grips the counter. >> BAKER: Finish washing. ~~ [C] Collector retains the receipt; Ama's 01 trembles beyond it. No joke reaction.

1|22|four_regular|NIL trades anonymity for a question.|[C] NIL dries their hands and puts both gloves back on; the right glove is still wet. ~~ [M] Bazaar road remains open behind them; Baker holds the bun. >> BAKER: You've nearly earned it. // NIL: Keep it a moment. ~~ [W] NIL crosses into the space between Tobi and the case; maintain the arch's axis. ~~ [C] Their fear is visible beneath a steady question. >> NIL: Before you take anything else—whose six are those?

2|1|three_horizontal|Continue the interruption without a reset.|[W] Same arch and positions: NIL left, case centre, Collector right, Ama and Tobi behind NIL. >> COLLECTOR: Stand clear. ~~ [C] NIL's wet right glove hovers short of the case. >> NIL: Whose six? ~~ [C] Ama reaches for her own retained receipt. >> AMA: That copy is mine.

2|2|four_regular|Ama supplies the facts.|[M] Collector shelters his notice with Ama's paper. >> COLLECTOR: After settlement. ~~ [C] Ama holds his gaze. >> AMA: It was settled Tuesday. ~~ [C] Old authorization crossed out; corrected mark in the same dated ink. >> COLLECTOR: Different authorization. ~~ [M] Ama points, not pleading. >> AMA: Your office changed the form.

2|3|three_horizontal|The appeal requires what he is taking.|[C] Collector's thumb finds his belt stamp. >> COLLECTOR: Request a corrected receipt. ~~ [M] Ama's outstretched hand remains empty. >> AMA: I need this one back to ask. ~~ [C] Tobi hugs the parcel tighter as the man considers the loop. >> COLLECTOR: Request a duplicate.

2|4|four_regular|Let Tobi's joke meet an adult silence.|[M] Ama indicates the empty old office lane. >> AMA: The office moved. ~~ [C] Collector looks at his notice. >> COLLECTOR: Its successor, then. ~~ [C] Tobi looks up, genuinely puzzled. >> TOBI: Do offices get children? ~~ [M] Ama does not answer; her eyes stay on the equipment. Hold the lost rhythm.

2|5|three_horizontal|Put a time limit on the family.|[C] Ama tucks a trembling hand beneath her shawl. >> AMA: How long do I have? ~~ [C] Collector unfolds the execution line. >> COLLECTOR: Until this notice is executed. ~~ [W] Rain connects case, rail terminal and waiting family; expose the brass channel physically.

2|6|three_horizontal|Civic zero has concrete social costs.|[C] Tobi watches the trembling 01. >> TOBI: What happens at zero? ~~ [M] Collector protects his paper from rain. >> COLLECTOR: Priority review. ~~ [C] Ama looks tired and furious, not helpless. >> AMA: Zero can't take the ferry alone. The clinic needs a guarantee.

2|7|three_horizontal|The unanswered cost forces a choice.|[M] Ama leans forward across the channel. >> AMA: Who pays the escort while I wait? ~~ [C] Collector's stamp hand remains still. >> COLLECTOR: Depends on the review. ~~ [W] Baker signals NIL toward the open Bazaar road; NIL stays beside Ama.

2|8|three_horizontal|Identify the six as an existing source.|[C] Six lights circle a lid contact; no new lights appear. >> NIL: Those? ~~ [M] Ama points to the jar, not NIL's decoder. >> AMA: My last six. Taken when the notice was filed. ~~ [C] Her corrected receipt reflects in the cover glass. >> AMA: Tuesday's fee was paid. The return was promised.

2|9|four_regular|The final seizure contradicts the pending return.|[M] Collector aligns the terminal key. >> COLLECTOR: Pending verification. ~~ [C] Ama's 01 and the jar's six share the frame. >> AMA: You take the last one before checking the six? ~~ [C] Collector's eyes avoid hers. >> COLLECTOR: Separate actions. ~~ [C] NIL compares the two authorization marks. >> NIL: The records disagree.

2|10|three_horizontal|A reasonable pause becomes a locked cover.|[M] Collector hesitates; NIL briefly hopes. >> NIL: It should add up. ~~ [C] Receipt slides under the clear terminal plate. >> COLLECTOR: Discrepancy attached to review. ~~ [EC] Key turns; cover locks over the receipt. >> SFX: KLIK

2|11|wide_two_insets|Tobi's care makes the danger personal.|[C] Needle advances toward the red end mark. ~~ [M] Tobi sets the coat parcel carefully on stone and takes Ama's hand. >> AMA: Wait. ~~ [C] Collector turns another detent without meeting her eyes. >> COLLECTOR: You may appeal the result.

2|12|four_regular|The first intervention is physical and fails.|[M] NIL braces a boot and pulls the lever with the right hand. >> COLLECTOR: Don't. ~~ [C] Lever holds; wet glove tears across the palm. >> SFX: skrr ~~ [C] Decoder ring burns at the wrist; NIL gasps. ~~ [M] NIL releases it; Collector catches their elbow.

2|13|three_horizontal|Show the exit before NIL rejects it.|[W] NIL twists free; service steps are visible beside the bridge. ~~ [M] Ama draws Tobi behind her; Collector reaches toward his stamp. ~~ [C] NIL looks from the steps to the six lights. Their shoulders turn back toward the case.

2|14|three_horizontal|A route, not a universal magic lock.|[C] Trace lid contact to terminal and plate beneath Ama's receipt. ~~ [C] Empty return fitting beside the taking channel; the broken decoder gap appears in a separate inset. ~~ [M] NIL stays; right wrist approaches the empty fitting. >> COLLECTOR: Move away.

2|15|three_horizontal|The connection costs pain before power.|[C] Right decoder touches the fitting; injured palm stays visibly scraped. >> SFX: tik ~~ [EC] NIL's pupil widens; no omniscient historical image. ~~ [S] Three small sensory fragments: hand with plank, hand passing cup, fingers closing around thread. No faces or origin caption.

2|16|three_horizontal|NIL chooses a bounded action without certainty.|[M] Contact steadies; NIL holds the right wrist in place. >> COLLECTOR: What did you do? ~~ [C] Their left hand reaches the lever. >> NIL: I don't know yet. ~~ [EC] Left fingers turn the lever back one notch. A return channel lights.

2|17|three_horizontal|Each departure must have a visible arrival.|[C] One light exits the jar along the channel; Ama 01 changes to 02. ~~ [M] Collector grabs for the lever; NIL holds it with the LEFT hand, breath caught. ~~ [C] Remaining lights stay countable in the glass; Ama's startled eyes track the change.

2|18|three_horizontal|Complete the transfer without creation.|[C] Fourth and fifth arrivals shown as successive insets, never extra jar lights. ~~ [C] Last light crosses; jar empty and Ama 07 share one unambiguous frame. ~~ [M] NIL pulls the wrist free; NaN remains unresolved. Red smear on the lever, not gore.

2|19|four_regular|Restore ordinary tasks after terror.|[M] Terminal cover releases; Ama retrieves her receipt. >> SFX: click ~~ [M] Ama pulls Tobi close; he still holds the coat awkwardly. ~~ [C] Ama's laugh catches into tears. >> AMA: Thank you. ~~ [C] Tobi offers the parcel back as if finishing the interrupted delivery.

2|20|three_horizontal|The bun changes hands correctly.|[M] Baker gives the bun to Tobi. ~~ [C] Tobi presses it into NIL's LEFT palm. >> TOBI: You finished. // NIL: I didn't. ~~ [C] Tobi attempts a stern business judgment through relief. >> TOBI: Nearly clean.

2|21|three_horizontal|Recognition becomes the new threat.|[C] Collector sees NaN now that NIL is clear of the awning. >> COLLECTOR: What account is that? ~~ [C] His whistle rises; NIL instinctively tries to hide the wound. >> SFX: PHEE ~~ [W] Opposite gate lifts; a brass machine's four stamp feet enter view.

2|22|four_regular|NIL draws the pursuit away from the family.|[M] Baker sends Ama and Tobi toward the laundry stairs. >> BAKER: Go. ~~ [C] Ama hesitates at NIL's right hand; NIL raises the bun in the unhurt left. >> NIL: Go. ~~ [W] NIL steps away from the family's route. >> NIL: Here! ~~ [L] Hound foot lands between NIL and the service stair; four feet, mechanical lens. >> CAPTION: Count the remaining exits.

3|1|wide_two_insets|Re-establish pursuit geography.|[W] Canal, service stair and Hound; only two apparent routes. ~~ [C] Brown fast water below; a bargeman argues with the weather. >> NIL: Generous to call that an exit. ~~ [M] Hound blocks the first stair, reserve vessel rattling.

3|2|three_horizontal|Keep the machine an enforcement tool.|[C] Hound muzzle seam releases a printed warrant strip. >> SFX: zzt ~~ [C] Stamp foot pins the strip into wet stone. ~~ [M] Collector behind NIL; Hound ahead. >> COLLECTOR: Account holder, remain. // NIL: That's the problem.

3|3|three_diagonal|The escape depends on a committed lunge.|[W] Hound lunges at NIL's shoulder line; railing behind them visible. ~~ [M] NIL ducks beneath the trajectory; jaws close on iron. >> SFX: KLANG ~~ [W] NIL passes the LEFT flank toward the steps while the machine tears free.

3|4|three_horizontal|Carry the wound and food into the chase.|[C] Seven wet steps under NIL's boots. ~~ [C] RIGHT palm pulses; bun moves from LEFT hand into the coat pocket. ~~ [W] Family footsteps above go toward laundry stairs; NIL takes the lower lane away from them.

3|5|wide_two_insets|Laundry provides actual navigable obstacles.|[W] Lane divides around washhouse; three low laundry lines create layers. ~~ [M] NIL ducks the first line and pushes through a sheet. ~~ [C] Peg clamps the longer LEFT coat tail. >> SFX: tak

3|6|four_regular|A small object refuses to cooperate.|[C] NIL looks back at the tiny wooden peg, appalled. >> NIL: Really? ~~ [C] Hound strikes bridge stone behind them. >> SFX: THUD ~~ [C] LEFT fingers pry the peg open; no costume tear required. ~~ [M] NIL runs; peg remains on the line.

3|7|two_large|Spend the joke on the machine, not a victim.|[W] Hound barrels into the sheet NIL evaded. ~~ [M] Sheet wraps its muzzle like an angry parcel; one glass lens peers through a fold. >> SFX: WHUFF // CAPTION: Perhaps four seconds.

3|8|three_horizontal|The next door is a visible possibility.|[W] Locked lane gate, courtyard beyond, woman with a bucket near an open door. ~~ [M] NIL waves; woman reaches for latch. ~~ [EC] Brass pin shoots from the post. >> SFX: CLACK

3|9|three_horizontal|The decoder is not a universal key.|[M] Woman recoils; bucket spills. ~~ [C] NIL presses the RIGHT wrist against the latch; no matching fitting or connected jar. ~~ [C] Pain, no opening. NIL flinches and withdraws. >> WOMAN: Other way!

3|10|wide_two_insets|A neighbour sees a physical route.|[W] Linen cart blocks a door-sized recess beside the gate. ~~ [C] NIL points through the bars at the cart. >> NIL: The cart. ~~ [M] Woman sets the bucket down, following their plan with her own judgment.

3|11|three_horizontal|Cooperation has material cost.|[M] Woman pushes one cart end through the wide gap; NIL takes the other. ~~ [W] Cart rotates across the lane, opening the recess behind it. ~~ [C] Woman eyes her washing, furious but committed. >> WOMAN: That's my washing. // NIL: Sorry. // WOMAN: Elsewhere.

3|12|three_diagonal|Move from impact to an earned opening.|[W] Hound hits cart; linen and wheels skid across its path. >> SFX: KRRASH ~~ [M] NIL squeezes behind it toward mismatched wooden boards. ~~ [C] Open hand carved into the door; latch lifts under NIL's uninjured hand.

3|13|wide_two_insets|The refuge acts before it asks.|[M] NIL slips inside; door closes against cart noise. ~~ [C] An older hand shields a lamp and moves it behind ledgers. ~~ [C] NIL reaches toward bolt. >> NOUGHT: Don't lock it.

3|14|three_horizontal|A practical reason prevents mystification.|[C] NIL freezes over the bolt. >> NIL: Why? ~~ [M] Nought stays by the lamp, listening. >> NOUGHT: It squeaks. The latch is quieter. ~~ [C] Hound foot shadows pass beneath door; cart resident complains outside. No creature pain sounds.

3|15|wide_two_insets|Let the chase's sound drain away.|[W] Small shrine room: pan under leak, repaired chair, ledgers supporting shelves, ribboned terminal. ~~ [C] NIL's hand remains on the latch after metal footsteps fade. ~~ [M] Nought leaves water and clean cloth within reach. >> NOUGHT: The chair is better than it looks.

3|16|four_regular|Humour is permission to investigate.|[C] Cord around chair leg; NIL suspicious. >> NIL: How reliable? ~~ [M] Nought sits to demonstrate. >> NOUGHT: Nobody dropped this week. ~~ [C] One eyebrow lifts; NIL measures the claim against the hour. >> NIL: It's morning. ~~ [M] Nought stands, leaving it for them. >> NOUGHT: Right to investigate. I'm Nought.

3|17|three_horizontal|No debt is attached to the seat.|[M] NIL scans exits and bowls, searching for the price. >> NIL: I can't pay. ~~ [C] Nought waits rather than taking the hand. >> NOUGHT: For the chair? // NIL: Hiding. ~~ [M] NIL sits at last. >> NOUGHT: Sit before I become ambitious.

3|18|three_horizontal|Care requires the hand's permission.|[C] NIL removes the torn RIGHT glove, palm scrape visible. ~~ [M] Nought places cloth and water down. >> NOUGHT: May I? // NIL: Yes. ~~ [C] Dressing goes around palm, fingers free; decoder remains fused. >> NOUGHT: The scrape should heal. The wrist is another question.

3|19|four_regular|The bun becomes shared food, not rent.|[C] NIL unfolds the crushed bun from coat pocket. >> NIL: I have this. ~~ [M] Nought divides it, returns the larger piece. ~~ [C] NIL studies the unfair halves. >> NIL: You have less. // NOUGHT: Had breakfast. ~~ [M] Two ordinary cups of water; NIL eats without resolving whether it is payment.

3|20|three_horizontal|Give the lost hours a visible transition.|[M] NIL dozes in the chair; Nought rinses cups, leaving them alone. ~~ [W] Later grey afternoon light around shutter; leak pan has been emptied. ~~ [M] NIL wakes as Nought mends a form sleeve. >> NIL: Will they say I stole the six?

3|21|three_horizontal|Separate personhood from a working registry.|[M] NIL traces jar six to Ama seven with LEFT fingers. >> NIL: One became seven. Six became none. ~~ [C] Nought listens, not diagnosing an origin. >> NIL: I wanted an account. A name. ~~ [C] Nought meets their eyes. >> NOUGHT: A number won't make you a person. You already are.

3|22|four_regular|End on an informed choice, not a cure.|[W] Back door, chair and ribboned terminal in one frame. >> NOUGHT: Rest. Leave when it's clear. Or try the station together. ~~ [C] NIL looks at the terminal ribbon. >> NOUGHT: It connects to city records. I can't promise the result. ~~ [C] NIL looks from the ribbon to Nought, uncertainty in their parted mouth. >> NIL: Will you tell me what to choose? ~~ [C] Nought keeps his hands off the terminal and leaves the silence open. >> NOUGHT: What choices mean. // NIL: Not the same. // NOUGHT: No.

4|1|three_horizontal|Retain consent after the chapter break.|[M] Nought puts cups in basin, leaving terminal untouched. ~~ [C] NIL watches his hands, waiting for a sudden lever pull that does not come. ~~ [W] Chair and terminal separated by a clear step. >> NOUGHT: Would you like the chair closer?

4|2|three_horizontal|An ordinary movement belongs to NIL.|[M] NIL carries the repaired chair themself. >> NIL: Does it need to be? // NOUGHT: Only if you want to sit. ~~ [C] Terminal handle polished by many hands; carefully tied worn ribbon. ~~ [C] NIL's thumb hovers near it. >> NIL: Did their Naming work? // NOUGHT: Yes.

4|3|three_horizontal|Two records do different work.|[M] Nought lays an unused small notebook beside the wired terminal. >> NOUGHT: A name you offer. What the city puts in its book. ~~ [C] Notebook has no connection wire. >> NIL: That one doesn't connect? ~~ [C] Nought leaves it available, no proprietary flourish. >> NOUGHT: It's for you, if you want it.

4|4|four_regular|The private designation enters speech.|[C] NIL draws back the cuff with LEFT fingers; dressed RIGHT palm rests. ~~ [EC] Inside brass ring, the engraved NIL field. >> NIL: The clerk crossed it out. ~~ [M] Nought looks at the letters, not the overhead NaN. >> NOUGHT: In an account field? ~~ [C] NIL's jaw firms; the cuff stays clenched in their LEFT fingers. >> NIL: Everyone tells me what it isn't.

4|5|three_horizontal|Do not prescribe a better identity.|[C] Nought lowers the pencil. >> NOUGHT: What is it to you? ~~ [M] NIL looks at folded rejected form and intact brass letters together. >> NIL: It's been with me. I could choose something else. ~~ [C] They wait for approval. >> NIL: Better? // NOUGHT: I don't decide that.

4|6|two_large|Give the chosen name a quiet climax.|[C] NIL looks up, nervous and deliberate. >> NIL: Nil. For me. Not for the box. ~~ [C] Nought writes Nil with small i and l, showing the page. >> NOUGHT: Nil.

4|7|three_horizontal|Social acceptance works before the terminal.|[C] Nil's LEFT hand touches the dry margin beside the name. ~~ [M] Same cramped room, same pan and painful hand; no supernatural transformation. >> NOUGHT: Change it. Or keep it. ~~ [C] Nil allows a small real smile. >> NIL: Keep it.

4|8|three_horizontal|Preparation is visible and finite.|[C] Nought seats the wall connector and checks its small retaining pin. ~~ [C] Reserve gauge and old forms checked, notebook left open beside them. ~~ [M] Nil follows the order, anxious to remember. >> NOUGHT: This records a practice digit. A resonance.

4|9|four_regular|Separate resonance from Civic allocation.|[C] One-digit practice window versus wider account window, clearly different housings. >> NOUGHT: Not the protection assigned to an account. ~~ [C] Nil recalls Ama's recovered 07 as a small memory inset, not a new event. >> NIL: Ama has seven now. ~~ [M] Nought gestures only to the practice window. >> NOUGHT: Choosing seven doesn't take hers. ~~ [C] Nil's brow unclenches slightly.

4|10|three_horizontal|Naming does not create a child.|[M] Nil studies the worn ribbon. >> NIL: Why seven? ~~ [C] Nought thinks they mean the ceremony's age. >> NOUGHT: Children already have names. Protection too. ~~ [C] Nil looks back at him. >> NIL: I meant why I would choose it.

4|11|three_horizontal|Reject the hunt for the approved answer.|[C] Nought slides the forms out of Nil's anxious eyeline. >> NOUGHT: I'm asking you. ~~ [M] Nil looks between the ordinary chair and the ordinary digit wheel. ~~ [C] A seven engraved in a service marker; no prophecy imagery. >> CAPTION: It need not justify a whole life.

4|12|two_large|Choice is an ordinary right.|[C] Nil lifts their eyes. >> NIL: Seven. ~~ [M] Nought's response is calm, equally open to another answer. >> NOUGHT: All right. It speaks to the city. We can still stop.

4|13|three_horizontal|Keep exit and notebook in the choice.|[W] Back door remains accessible, chosen name in notebook near Nil. ~~ [C] Nil considers both before placing the wrist. >> NIL: I want to try. ~~ [C] Nought demonstrates the lift-clear motion and keeps a hand near disconnect.

4|14|wide_two_insets|A brief success is allowed to feel good.|[C] RIGHT wrist rests on cradle without pressing the injured palm. ~~ [EC] Practice window settles on 7. >> SFX: tik ~~ [C] Nil leans forward; Nought's cautious smile meets theirs.

4|15|three_horizontal|Let the failure take time.|[C] Wider account window remains black. ~~ [C] Same view, a second later; Nil's smile holds too hard. ~~ [C] NaN appears; practice7 remains in its separate frame. >> SFX: zzt

4|16|three_horizontal|Do not make the choice the error.|[C] Nil's face falls, small and exposed. >> NIL: Did I choose wrong? ~~ [M] Nought meets Nil's falling gaze immediately, palm open beside the disconnect. >> NOUGHT: No. ~~ [C] His gaze turns to the wall connection, not Nil's seven. >> NOUGHT: That's not what it's asking.

4|17|three_horizontal|The machine communicates outside the room.|[C] Relay clicks inside wall. >> SFX: tik ~~ [C] Nought pulls disconnect; practice7 stays recorded. ~~ [M] Another relay answers farther down the lane; Nought listens with changed posture. >> NIL: What did it ask?

4|18|three_horizontal|Protect the person before solving the device.|[C] Nought closes the notebook and places it in Nil's LEFT hand. >> NOUGHT: Under your coat. ~~ [C] Nil clutches it, eyes on terminal. >> NIL: I broke it. ~~ [M] Nought lifts lamp and opens back door. >> NOUGHT: Not you. This way.
